title: Generated Reference Pipeline
summary: Scope, regeneration and authority of source references.
html:
Generated Reference Pipeline

The manual loads authored Markdown and generates current references when its app is constructed. Restart the service or use ./startmanual.sh --reload after edits. The source scope manifest classifies maintained implementation (Tier A), current operational tooling (Tier B), and excluded validation/history (Tier C).

File contracts, routes, imports, environment names and storage owners are inspected statically. The capability page constructs the source-owned in-memory registration catalog; it does not execute tools, evaluate remote availability, or open services. No model or Gateway is needed. The manual builds its own search index from the resulting corpus; historical pages retain their separate navigation category.

Run .venv/bin/python scripts/source_documentation_audit.py --check before review. The audit and source pages share the same inventory. A missing contract remains visible in the catalog and fails the audit rather than hiding the source file.
